name: GenExam
intro: GenExam 是覆盖十个学科的多学科文生图考试基准。它以参考真值图、考试式提示和原子评分点衡量模型生成包含复杂学科知识图像的能力，并提供严格分与宽松分。
build_method: 多源图像收集, GPT-5筛选与提示起草, 博士标注员交叉复核
task_type: 文生图, 多学科考试评测
eval_feature: 原子评分点, 参考图GPT-5裁判, 严格与宽松计分
build_method_en: Multi-source Image Collection, GPT-5 Filtering and Prompt Drafting, Cross-validation by PhD Annotators
eval_feature_en: Atomic Scoring Points, Reference-image GPT-5 Judge, Strict and Relaxed Scoring
intro_en: GenExam is a multidisciplinary text-to-image examination benchmark spanning ten subjects. Reference images, exam-style prompts, and atomic scoring points measure whether models can generate complex images containing subject knowledge, with both strict and relaxed scores.

drawio_review_note: Verified against arXiv:2509.14232v5 (Sections 3.1-3.2, Appendices A-B, Figures 8 and 10), OpenGVLab/GenExam at commit 6f324dd1ca23511759a409aa28783075db68bf99 (README.md, data/annotations/All_Subjects.jsonl, data/mini_sample_ids.txt, eval_prompt.py, run_eval.py, cal_score.py), and the OpenGVLab/GenExam dataset at revision 0782259dc19f6528a0b02268afccb85e0a2495ad. The four-level ISCED-F taxonomy has 10/40/132/236 categories; about 40K candidate images are filtered heuristically and by GPT-5 to 6.5K, then GPT-5 drafts weighted yes/no points and three PhD annotators review the image, prompt, and points before the 1,000-item release. Figure 8 and both pinned mini_sample_ids.txt files contain 250 IDs; the README block showing 487 evaluation results is a report example, not the Mini cardinality. The pinned judge is gpt-5-2025-08-07 with low reasoning, generated and reference images, weighted semantic points, and three 0-2 global ratings. Strict requires every point yes and every global rating 2; relaxed scoring is semantic×0.7 plus each global rating×0.1/2.
